author: MiniWarGaming
description:
This game is totally not 11th Edition 40k. We took the rules that Warhammer Community has previewed on the website and added them to 10th Edition! Josh and Skari have a good time mixing things up and using some cool new terrain layouts and rolling some dice to see how it feels!
